MAYOR: MAYOR-1: IdleService.idle signal has no subscriber — no artefact is designated to trigger logout when the 2-minute countdown expires. The spec criterion 'session closes automatically if no action taken in 2 minutes' has no implementation path.

MAYOR-2: MatDialog.disableClose not specified — default MatDialog allows ESC/backdrop to close the dialog silently, leaving warning signal stuck at true and no re-open mechanism, directly violating the 'bloqueante' requirement.
MENOR: MENOR-1: IdleWarningDialogComponent placement contradicts its own justification (text says core/auth, file structure says layout/components).
MENOR-2: MockAuthProvider (GAP-5) excluded from Archivos a modificar despite being identified as a gap.
MENOR-3: BroadcastChannel has no documented fallback for the ~3% of browsers without support.
MENOR-4: Rule 7 wording ('NO los debe definir') contradicts styling.instructions.md mandatory data-testid requirement.
MENOR-5: AuthService will accumulate 12+ responsibilities post-implementation; extraction threshold not documented.

verdict: NEEDS_REVISION: Architect must resolve MAYOR-1 (designate subscriber for IdleService.idle logout trigger) and MAYOR-2 (specify disableClose: true in MatDialog config) before QA phase begins.
notes: Tech Lead audit completed. Design is architecturally sound in its 4 main decisions. 2 MAYOR findings block QA advance. 5 MENOR findings documented for Architect awareness. Implementation sequence (8 steps) provided in plan.md for use after revision.
